class.name: PhysicsCollideShapeResult3D
class.brief_description: Stores the collision points of a shape collision query.
class.description: This class contains the contact points computed by [method PhysicsDirectSpaceState3D.collide_shape_into]. Each collision is represented as a pair of points: one on the query shape and one on the colliding shape.

method.name: get_collision_count
method.description: Returns the number of point pairs detected by the query.

method.name: get_point_on_colliding_shape
method.description: Returns the collision point on the colliding shape for the collision at the given index.

method.name: get_point_on_queried_shape
method.description: Returns the collision point on the query shape for the collision at the given index.

members.member: The maximum number of collisions this object can store.
